one_line: A Balti princess and a Ladakhi king whose political marriage shaped frontier diplomacy between Baltistan and Ladakh in the late 16th century.

appearance.age_look: both appear in their early thirties, athletic but slender, with poised, disciplined bearing
appearance.face: Gyal Khatun has an oval face with fair-to-wheatish Himalayan complexion, straight nose, soft arched brows and large serious eyes with a calm, assessing gaze; Jamyang Namgyal has a slightly broader face, medium wheatish complexion, strong straight nose, defined jaw, sharp brows and focused yet diplomatic expression, both defaulting to composed determination rather than overt emotion.
appearance.hair: Gyal Khatun’s straight black hair is center-parted, braided into two long neat plaits wrapped in a dark maroon woolen headscarf that crosses over the crown and ties low at the back, leaving the front of the braids visible; Jamyang Namgyal’s thick black hair is shoulder-length, slightly wavy, brushed back from the forehead, wearing a simple dark indigo Ladakhi-style felt cap with a narrow turned-up brim and a small muted turquoise cabochon at the front.
appearance.costume: Gyal Khatun wears a long-sleeved, ankle-length Balti-style robe resembling a Central Asian tunic, made of deep maroon wool with a straight cut, side slits, and a subtle narrow geometric border in dark gold at hem and cuffs; under it is a high-collared pale cream inner dress visible at the neckline and cuffs, and around her waist is a soft dark teal sash tied to one side; she has a modest multi-strand necklace of small silver beads with a single turquoise pendant, simple silver hoop earrings, and sturdy brown leather shoes with slightly upturned toes; Jamyang Namgyal wears a Ladakhi goncha-style robe in rich dark indigo wool, calf-length with broad sleeves, wrapped left over right and secured with a wide rust-red woolen belt, the robe edged with a narrow dark brown border; beneath, a warm ochre inner shirt shows at the collar, and he has fitted dark brown woolen trousers tucked into stout brown leather boots; his accessories include a plain silver bracelet, small turquoise and coral bead necklace partly hidden by the collar, and a practical dark brown leather belt over the sash to hold his sword scabbard, keeping the look firmly royal yet functional to the frontier mountain setting.
appearance.signature: A single sheathed straight-backed Himalayan sword with a dark brown leather scabbard and simple bronze fittings that Jamyang Namgyal wears at his left hip, while Gyal Khatun rests one hand lightly near the hilt to signify their shared role in frontier diplomacy and political alliance.

ref_desc: Gyal Khatun and Jamyang Namgyal appear as early-thirties Himalayan royals with composed expressions, braided and shoulder-length black hair, maroon Balti and indigo Ladakhi robes, modest silver-turquoise jewellery, brown leather boots, and a single sheathed straight-backed sword in deep maroon, indigo, teal, rust red and turquoise accents.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Gyal Khatun and Jamyang Namgyal standing side by side in a frontier mountain setting: Gyal Khatun is a Balti princess with an oval fair-to-wheatish face, calm serious eyes, center-parted long black hair braided into two neat plaits, partly wrapped by a dark maroon woolen headscarf crossing over her crown; she wears a long-sleeved, ankle-length deep maroon wool robe in Balti style with straight cut and subtle dark gold geometric borders at hem and cuffs, a pale cream high-collared inner dress visible at neckline and cuffs, a dark teal sash tied at her waist, modest silver and turquoise necklace, simple silver hoop earrings, and sturdy brown leather shoes with slightly upturned toes. Beside her, Jamyang Namgyal is a Ladakhi king with a broader wheatish face, sharp focused eyes and disciplined yet diplomatic expression, shoulder-length slightly wavy black hair brushed back, and a simple dark indigo felt Ladakhi cap with a narrow turned-up brim and a small turquoise cabochon at the front; he wears a dark indigo wool goncha-style robe wrapped left over right, calf-length with broad sleeves and narrow dark brown edging, secured with a wide rust-red wool belt, over an ochre inner shirt at the collar, with dark brown wool trousers tucked into stout brown leather boots. His accessories are minimal: a plain silver bracelet, a partly visible turquoise and coral bead necklace at the collar, and a practical dark brown leather belt over the sash holding his signature straight-backed Himalayan sword in a dark brown leather scabbard with simple bronze fittings at his left hip, with Gyal Khatun’s hand lightly near the hilt. Emphasize consistent anime proportions, dignified frontier diplomacy energy, and the defined colour palette of deep maroon, dark indigo, dark teal, rust red and turquoise.
